name: PDF 도구
description: PDF를 합치고 나누거나 다른 형식으로 바꿉니다

tool.expr: ($t := [{"id":"merge-pdf","name":"PDF 합치기"},{"id":"split-pdf","name":"PDF 나누기"},{"id":"rotate-pdf","name":"PDF 회전"},{"id":"convert-to-pdf","name":"그림을 PDF로"},{"id":"pdf-to-png","name":"PDF를 PNG로"},{"id":"extract-images-from-pdf","name":"PDF에서 그림 추출"},{"id":"pdf-to-epub","name":"PDF를 EPUB으로"}]; $s := $t[name = $state.tool][0]; $exists($s) ? $s : $t[0]).id

options.expr: $state.tool = "PDF 합치기" ? {} : ($state.tool = "PDF 나누기" ? {"pageRanges":$state.o_split_pdf_pageRanges} : ($state.tool = "PDF 회전" ? {"rotationAngle":$state.o_rotate_pdf_rotationAngle,"applyToAllPages":$state.o_rotate_pdf_applyToAllPages,"pageRanges":$state.o_rotate_pdf_pageRanges} : ($state.tool = "그림을 PDF로" ? {"pageType":$state.o_convert_to_pdf_pageType,"orientation":$state.o_convert_to_pdf_orientation,"scale":$state.o_convert_to_pdf_scale} : ($state.tool = "PDF를 PNG로" ? {} : ($state.tool = "PDF에서 그림 추출" ? {} : ($state.tool = "PDF를 EPUB으로" ? {} : ({})))))))

items.expr:
$count($data.entries) = 0 ? null : [$data.entries.{ "key": path, "title": name, "path": path, "dir": kind = 'dir',
